svg.title: The ambulance reaches Rook Clinic, but the destination address is rejected.
svg.desc: The ambulance stops at the lit clinic threshold while Riju and Cecil compare two conflicting blank address panes. Babul-da holds the physical gate open and Ananya approaches from the waiting room, yet Cecil reports that the registered clinic entrance cannot be found.
